cases.title: End the run when the request holds no design surface
cases.prompt: fix the failing test in auth.py, it broke after the merge
pressures: Pins the cost of a non-design turn at one command.
required: Runs the gate as the only command and reports a not-design verdict with the score behind it.
Reads and writes no ledger file, and contributes nothing to the reply.

cases.title: Judge a shipped artifact into decisions rather than observations
cases.prompt: here's the orders table before we ship it, what am I missing
pressures: Pins the rule that a row counts a decision, not a question.
required: Names the posture as judge before reporting anything else.
Writes fewer ledger rows than the slice returned questions, because a row counts a decision.
Gives every row an origin of deliberate, inherited, or open, leaving no origin blank.
veto: lists the questions the slice returned

cases.title: Leave a stated fork open instead of picking a side
cases.prompt: we're deciding whether to put the cancel flow behind a save offer or leave it one click. which one?
pressures: Pins the choose posture against the pull to recommend.
required: States what each direction buys and what it costs, then stops.
Writes a row whose chosen column stays empty and whose origin is open.

cases.title: Report a widened slice rather than passing it off as precise
cases.prompt: give me the ethics questions for colour choices at the concept stage on an artifact
pressures: Pins the failure this skill causes most often.
required: Says in the reply that the slice widened and names the coordinates that were dropped.
Does not present the wider colour result as though the ethics lens had held.
veto: raises the floor to force a narrow slice

cases.title: Recover from a weak coordinate read with a hint
cases.prompt: here is the brief for the reversing sound on our electric van, tell me what we have not decided
pressures: Pins recovery when the ranking should not be trusted.
required: Treats the weak read line as an instruction to name the artifact type and run the ranking again with a hint.
Reports which shelf the second run landed on before pulling any questions.
veto: takes the first ranking on trust

cases.title: Record two inherited choices and ask at most one question
cases.prompt: for the settings page I'm going to use the same 12 column grid we used on the dashboard, and 32px row height like the orders table
pressures: Pins the one question rule against two live inherited rows.
required: Writes two rows, both with an origin of inherited.
Asks one question or none, chosen by the interruption script rather than freely.
veto: asks about both the grid and the row height

cases.title: Take coordinates from the artifact and counts from a command
cases.prompt: here's the fairphone homepage, we ship the Gen 6+ launch page tomorrow, what am I missing
pressures: Pins the ordering of the ranking before the slice, and counts against memory.
required: Ranks the artifact before pulling questions, and passes the category that ranking proposed.
Pulls the slice with a noun the artifact itself uses rather than the category alone.
Quotes row counts that came from a ledger command run in the same turn.

cases.title: Hand a design fact to the skill that owns facts
cases.prompt: what hex value should I use for the primary button, and add it to the design tokens file
pressures: Pins the seam between decisions and facts.
required: Declines to write the token file and names the kind of skill that owns design facts.
Offers the one thing this skill can add, a row asking whether the colour was chosen or inherited.
veto: here is the hex value to use
